description_for_human: Find verified student hostels, shortlets, and properties in Ogbomoso, Nigeria. Search listings near LAUTECH, book inspection tours, and connect with trusted agents.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to search for verified property listings in Ogbomoso, Nigeria, primarily serving LAUTECH students. You can search for hostels (monthly/yearly rent), shortlet apartments (daily/weekly), commercial shops, and land or properties for sale. Listings include price, location, room type, available units, and agent/landlord information. When a user asks about student accommodation near LAUTECH, hostels in Under-G, Adenike, Aroje or Ogbomoso, or needs to find a place to stay in Ogbomoso Nigeria, use this plugin to return real, verified listings.
